text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
A five-square-foot tarp, a headlamp, a

compass-wristwatch, a blanket to warm
my legs,
and a thermos containing a hot
drink...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
And finally, this small, light-blue
cushion, since I
kind of like how it feels.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave my phone here. I don't need
anything
that'll disturb me... or cause
any glaring lights.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: All I want is to come talk with you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So, you've got permission for your
nighttime
outing. Hehe, it was a cinch
since you're so on top
of your
paperwork, Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Be careful not to be late coming back. I
know I
don't need to tell you, but a
reminder never hurts,
right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I know...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Good to hear. Well, then... have a nice
night of
stargazing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Thanks...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
What?! You're going stargazing tonight,
Ayabe?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Booo. And I even went and found some super cute animal vids for us to watch. Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh wait... Is tonight...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Just go to bed, and don't wait up for me
like last
time. You can go ahead and
turn off the bedroom
light.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...See you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: The new moon...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
This night comes approximately once
every thirty
days. The stars shine so
brightly.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Sister... I always feel closer to you during
this
special time.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm coming to talk, on this
night of the
new moon.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's something I've always done, even
before I
knew about you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Now it's my custom, a tradition I've
never broken
since learning what I lost.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Ah... I thought so.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(I can feel your presence a little more
strongly
tonight.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You know... I've decided to make my
debut.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm finally going to run in the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
So... I'm going to run for the life you
couldn't live,
the races you couldn't
race, and for everything
you missed out
on.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm going to run for you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'll run... and win. And I'll dedicate all
the honor to
you. So... just wait a little
longer.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Watch your big sister closely, okay?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(That's right. I'll keep winning race after
race.
Countless victories and the highest
honor... I'll
dedicate it all to you.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(That is my purpose. It's my only
motivation.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
That's right... I have... some news? I need
to tell
you something.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I have a trainer now. It's required in
order to
debut.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: My trainer is...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Someone I don't really understand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A little while has passed since I became
Admire
Vega's trainer, and we've begun
training seriously
for her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the talent and stoic attitude
she
inherited from her mother and her
sharp mind
capable of quickly take in
instructions, her
training has progressed
very smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I don't need your praise. Just tell me
what's next.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She constantly rejects what she
considers
unnecessary interference. It
feels like the distance
between us is still
large.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It isn't something I can forcefully resolve.
I'll have
to first gain her trust if I want to
close this gap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that on my mind, there's something
that
needs addressing...
choice_data_list: （俺自身が、ちゃんと努力してかないとな）
（私自身が、ちゃんと努力してかないと）

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's something I've noticed in the training
sessions
we've had up until now.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I see. So you want to reduce the stress
on her legs
caused by her skeletal
misalignment...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
As a matter of fact, I also noticed her
uneven
posture when she runs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And ever since, it's been affecting her
posture
and causing additional strain on
her legs.
choice_data_list: 生まれつき、左脚が少し歪んでいるみたいで

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I also learned from her documents that
the skin
on the soles of her feet is
thinner than average.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's responsible and independent
enough that
she's taking proper care of
herself. Thanks to
that, she hasn't
experienced any major issues.
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Hearing that sentiment come
from her
trainer is a good sign.
choice_data_list: 少しでも負担を軽くしてあげたくて

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please come to me if you need help with

anything, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her daily care routine seems sufficient,
so I want
to recommend her a more
comprehensive
improvement strategy.
choice_data_list: ありがとうございます！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After chatting a while with Tazuna, I
conclude
that...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The best way to help her form might be
to
improve the cleats she wears.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes! And I have a suggestion about that.
choice_data_list: 体質に合った蹄鉄のオーダーメイドとか！

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
How about you run the idea past Admire
Vega's
mother?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Her mother also suffered from the same
issue
during her active racing years, so
she might have
some good solutions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega's documents already
include contact
information for her
mother, so I decide to give
her a call and
carefully explain the situation.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
The shoemaker I used to get my own

custom-made cleats from is still taking
orders.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
From what you say, it sounds like
putting in an
order might be the best
thing to do. I'll give them
a call for you.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Not at all... If there's anything I can do
for my
child, this is certainly it.
choice_data_list: ありがとうございます……！

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer. This might be a little
forward of me,
but...

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Mother
text_block_list.text: Please, do everything you can for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You've ordered me new shoes with
custom-made
cleats?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: When did you...
choice_data_list: 君の体質に合わせて、作ってもらったんだ
貴方の体質に合わせて、作ってもらったんだ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her voice trails off in her confusion. She
runs her
fingers through the cleats a few
times before
trying them on and dashing
off at full speed.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hup!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(The ground is so soft! My legs feel... so
fast!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: They're... easy to run in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She taps her toes against the ground to
test the
feel of the footwear. The look
on her face still
appears stiff.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to slowly establish trust
between us as we
continue down this
path together. But in the
meantime... we
charge ahead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That is my solemn promise.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I don't get you at all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Nothing.
